chapter_title: The Interpretation of Happiness, Wisdom and Power;

¶4:** I
 will teach you of another b
lessedness, and

, and together
 another operative
 power. Listen
 now
,

ist together

ering affection that

 —

 its

 which is called the source

ial light

 doctrine

 in

lessedness is

;

ative principle of all

 from

ness of truth, and every ministering

¶7:** Again, bless
edness, understanding, and operative
 power exist within
 the containing
 doctrine
 of Divine
 Truth. The blessedness ther
ein is the interior
 will of the Divine.
 The understanding is
 Wisdom
 itself
 in
 its pure and
 uncorrupted form. And
 the power
 within
 this
 doctrine is every good, every fullness
 of truth, and every ministering aff
ection established
 and
 gr
ounded in

**¶8:**
 Again, these three exist within the fundamental
 planes of spiritual life themselves
: blessedness, understanding, and
 operative power. The blessedness is
 the Divine Influx connecting the
 highest to the lowest —
 the Divine Human form through
 which all degrees communicate
. The understanding is the essential
 tru
ths proceeding from the Divine Truth
 that
 structure
 and
 order
 creation
 at
 every level. And the operative power is
 the
 essential
 aff
ections of
 good
 proce
eding from the Lord

 pr
imal Divine
 Love
 —
 which

,

,

 whole.

Again, [h]appiness, wisdom and power exist in the s[hip of liv]ing waters [ ... ] the happiness [ ... ] the Mind of the Father. Also, wisdom [is the Vir]gi]n of [Li]ght. And the power that is [i]n the ship is [all] the go[ds], the [ri]ch ones and the angels who are established i[n it].
